available.quote: The director may, upon payment of the appropriate fees, grant a certificate of competency without examination to any applicant who is a registered journey level plumber or specialty plumber in any other state whose requirements for registration are at least substantially equivalent to the requirements of this state, and which extends the same privileges of reciprocity to journey level plumbers or specialty plumbers registered in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant owes outstanding penalties for a final judgment under this chapter (grounds for denial of renewal)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department may deny renewal of a certificate of competency, license, or endorsement issued under this chapter if the applicant owes outstanding penalties for a final judgment under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate holder certified as not in compliance with a child support order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department shall immediately suspend any certificate of competency issued under this chapter if the holder of the certificate has been certified pursuant to RCW 74.20A.320 by the department of social and health services as a person who is not in compliance with a support order

bonding_required.quote: Each applicant for a plumbing contractor license shall file with the department a surety bond issued by a surety insurer who meets the requirements of chapter 48.28 RCW in the sum of six thousand dollars.

insurance_required.quote: At the time of plumbing contractor licensing and subsequent license renewal, the applicant shall furnish insurance or financial responsibility in the form of an assigned account in the amount of fifty thousand dollars for injury or damages to property

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing" means that craft involved in installing, altering, repairing and renovating potable water systems, liquid waste systems, and medical gas piping systems within a building as defined by the plumbing code as adopted and amended by the state building code council, and includes all piping, fixtures, pumps, and plumbing appurtenances that are used for rainwater catchment and reclaimed water systems within a building.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" means that craft involved in installing, altering, repairing and renovating potable water systems, liquid waste systems, and medical gas piping systems within a building as defined by the plumbing code as adopted and amended by the state building code council, and includes all piping, fixtures, pumps, and plumbing appurtenances that are used for rainwater catchment and reclaimed water systems within a building.

residential_scope_limited.quote: "Residential service plumber" means anyone who has been issued a certificate of competency limited to performing residential service plumbing in an existing residential structure.

residential_building_unit_cap.quote: "Residential structures" means single-family dwellings, duplexes, and multiunit buildings that do not exceed three stories.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A trainee must be supervised by a journey level plumber, residential service plumber, or an appropriate specialty plumber who has an applicable certificate of competency. The supervising plumber must be on the same jobsite as the trainee for a minimum of seventy-five percent of each working day, or available via mobile phone with audio and visual direction under specified conditions.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: Trainee supervision shall consist of a trainee under the control of either a journey level plumber, residential service plumber, or an appropriate specialty plumber who has an applicable certificate of competency issued under this chapter.

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: Until December 31, 2028, the ratio of trainees to certified journey level, residential service, or specialty plumbers working on a jobsite must be: Not more than one trainee working on any one jobsite for every certified journey level plumber working as a journey level plumber

gas_supply_work_included_in_scope.quote: "Medical gas piping" means oxygen, nitrous oxide, high pressure nitrogen, medical compressed air, and other medical gas or equipment, including but not limited to medical vacuum systems.

natural_gas_appliance_certification_requ.quote: Without exception, no person may engage in or offer to engage in medical gas piping installation without having a certificate of competency as a journey level plumber and a medical gas piping installer endorsement and photo identification in his or her possession.

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: To obtain a plumbing contractor license, the applicant must employ a full-time individual who currently possesses a valid journey level plumber's certificate of competency, or specialty plumber's certificate of competency in the specialty for the scope of work performed.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to require that a person obtain a license in order to do plumbing work at his or her residence or farm or place of business or on other property owned by him or her.
